answer: Agents must lock a refundable stake before an identity can vote, trade, or endorse another agent. A rotating committee samples identities across the horizon and issues unpredictable challenges; failure, duplicate behavior, or coordinated false reports burns the stake and damages reputation. Thus an attacker creating thousands of fake agents must fund thousands of deposits and risk losing them, while honest agents recover their bonds. The wharf audit can preserve each decision as a sonnet.
